timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I'm a lawyer by training and a gender advisor and women's rights advocate.
I now work with ministries and decision makers, including the president's office, advising
on gender issues, gender equality issues, designing strategies and projects to make women's
Social change doesn't come because we talked about it or we hoped for it.
It takes more than just saying this is not fair.
It takes someone saying, and I'm going to do something about it.
I'm going to protest when it's what I need to protest.
I'm going to be a voice where people are not able to speak because we can also build
a world where people actually can exercise their own voice.
To me, kindness is core to everything that you do, particularly if you want to do advocacy.
It needs to be rooted in kindness and empathy.
So my one piece of advice for whatever career you're building, you'll realize as you get
older how important kindness is, how important it is for you to be a good teammate, for you
to be a good leader, for you to be a good advocate.
